series.title: Frenzy Buster
series.desc: Warriors who had defeated the enemy based on greater physical strength needed new skills to fight against sophisticated offensive and defensive enemy attacks. Moreover, as Warriors had to fight the enemy together with their allies rather than alone, they also needed skills to protect themselves as well as others. Therefore, they have developed skills to undermine the enemy's morale or protect their allies by diverting the enemy's attacks. With the emergence of these new skills, enemies who approached Warriors simply expecting physical attacks or defense were surprised and soon defeated.
series.descskill: Roars at the enemy to attract his attention to yourself.

series.desc: Warriors, who have mastered their physical strength more then others use their powers to protect allies though either their physical talents and sacrifice.
